title: MOF Synthesis Knowledge Graph Ontology v0.2
description: MOF-specific ontology for LLM-driven synthesis-record extraction, replacing the generic materials v0.1 after the 2026-06-10 project re-aim. Field names chosen to align with DigiMOF/SynMOF for the agreement analysis. Pending supervisor review before the annotation phase.

MOF.description: A metal-organic framework material. Includes common names, chemical formulas, and CSD refcodes.

MetalPrecursor.description: The metal salt or source compound supplying the metal node/cluster.

OrganicLinker.description: The organic ligand connecting metal nodes.

Solvent.description: Solvent or solvent mixture used in the synthesis.

SynthesisMethod.description: The synthesis route used to prepare the MOF.

Condition.description: A process or measurement condition (temperature, time, pressure, pH, atmosphere).

Property.description: A measured property of the MOF.

Application.description: A stated or demonstrated use case for the MOF.

MENTIONED_IN.note: Provenance edge - every entity must point to its source paper(s) and section.

open_questions: Property values as nodes (cross-paper aggregation) or attributes on HAS_PROPERTY edges?
Confidence score: per-triple float vs. LLM-self-reported categorical (high/med/low)?
Condition granularity: one typed Condition entity vs. separate Temperature/Time/pH entities?
Which fields map 1:1 onto DigiMOF/SynMOF schemas for the agreement analysis (metal, linker, solvent, temperature, time)?
Add Characterization technique (PXRD, BET, TGA) as a first-class entity in v0.3, or keep as Property.measurement_technique attribute?
